messages.content: Read the learned semantic source fields from the complete current rule material. Preserve roles, direction, clause scope and qualifications. Do not give any native hypothesis label or import old-source values. Use unknown with value null when the requested parameter cannot be established; extraction uncertainty is not False, an empty list or absence. Known fields require current-source supporting span IDs. The declared canonical vocabulary describes meanings, not words that must literally occur. Keep actor/recipient classes separate from protected information, conditions and examples.

{"task": {"source_spans": [{"id": 0, "field": "source_text", "start": 0, "end": 51, "text": "NON-DISCLOSURE AGREEMENT FOR PROSPECTIVE PURCHASERS"}, {"id": 1, "field": "source_text", "start": 52, "end": 528, "text": "I , ______________________, acknowledge and agree to the terms and conditions set forth herein as concerns a contemplated business relationship between parties, insofar as Vendor, (the “Disclosing Party”) desires to disclose to me (the “Receiving Party”) certain confidential and proprietary information (“Confidential Information”) in connection with a professional practice for sale by Vendor, represented exclusively by and through ROI Corporation (“Agent for the Vendor”)."}, {"id": 2, "field": "source_text", "start": 529, "end": 666, "text": "For the purposes of this Agreement, “Confidential Information” shall mean information that is used in Disclosing Party's business and is:"}, {"id": 3, "field": "source_text", "start": 667, "end": 724, "text": "(i) proprietary to, about or created by Disclosing Party;"}, {"id": 4, "field": "source_text", "start": 725, "end": 921, "text": "(ii) gives Disclosing Party some competitive business advantage or the opportunity of obtaining such advantage or the disclosure of which could be detrimental to the interests of Disclosing Party;"}, {"id": 5, "field": "source_text", "start": 922, "end": 1284, "text": "(iii) designated as Confidential Information by Disclosing Party, or from all the relevant circumstances should reasonably be assumed by Receiving Party to be confidential and proprietary to Disclosing Party including information and documentation clearly and conspicuously marked with a legend identifying its Confidential, Classified and Proprietary in nature:"}, {"id": 6, "field": "source_text", "start": 1285, "end": 1328, "text": "(iv) not generally known by Receiving Party"}, {"id": 7, "field": "source_text", "start": 1329, "end": 1914, "text": "For the purpose of this Agreement, Confidential Information shall also include, but is not necessarily limited to, any and all information, financial statements, legal documents, location of the practice(s), and identity of the Vendor, the fact that the practices are available for purchase, business records and plans, patient lists and records, employee lists and records, trade secrets, operations, technical information, pricing structure, costs, marketing strategies and market research and patient demographics pertaining to the professional practice(s) for which I am inquiring."}, {"id": 8, "field": "source_text", "start": 1915, "end": 2263, "text": "I hereby acknowledge and agree that all information pertaining to the professional practice(s) that I am introduced to by ROI Corporation shall be obtained exclusively through ROI Corporation and that I WILL NOT CONTACT THE OWNER(s), STAFF, PATIENTS or other advisors of the practice(s), unless I am ACCOMPANIED BY AN ASSOCIATE OF ROI CORPORATION. "}, {"id": 9, "field": "source_text", "start": 2263, "end": 2434, "text": "I further agree not to write or mark the Appraisal(s), nor shall I copy or reproduce any information in any manner whatsoever without the prior consent of ROI Corporation."}, {"id": 10, "field": "source_text", "start": 2435, "end": 2723, "text": "The Receiving Party shall take all practical steps to keep the Disclosing Party’s Confidential Information confidential and shall restrict access to the Confidential Information to those agents and professional advisers to whom disclosure is necessary in pursuit of the Approved Purpose. "}, {"id": 11, "field": "source_text", "start": 2723, "end": 2950, "text": "Each Party shall inform all such employees, agents and professional advisers of the provisions of this Agreement and shall be responsible for ensuring compliance with the said provisions by all agents and professional advisers."}, {"id": 12, "field": "source_text", "start": 2951, "end": 3268, "text": "Receiving Party acknowledges and agrees that due to the sensitive nature of the Confidential Information, any breach of this Agreement would cause irreparable harm to the Disclosing Party and that the Disclosing Party shall therefore be entitled to equitable relief in addition to all other remedies available at law."}, {"id": 13, "field": "source_text", "start": 3269, "end": 3376, "text": "In addition, the Receiving Party acknowledges that the following specific Confidential Information, namely:"}, {"id": 14, "field": "source_text", "start": 3377, "end": 3891, "text": "Knowledge of the identity of the Disclosing Party, coupled with the fact that that the Disclosing Party’s practice(s) are for sale, or that the Disclosing Party has commissioned appraisal(s) for the possible sale of same would, if disclosed by the Receiving Party and such information thereby came to the knowledge of STAFF (either employees or associates) of the practices, cause significant damages to the Disclosing Party though departure of STAFF and/or Patients, which damages would be difficult to quantify. "}, {"id": 15, "field": "source_text", "start": 3891, "end": 4297, "text": "Accordingly, Receiving Party acknowledges that a breach of this confidentiality agreement with respect to this specific Confidential Information which results in such information becoming known to STAFF and/or Patients will entitle Disclosing Party to liquidated damages in the sum of $250,000.00, it being expressly understood and agreed that such sum is a genuine pre-estimate of damages and not penalty."}, {"id": 16, "field": "source_text", "start": 4298, "end": 4556, "text": "All negotiating, drafting and presentations of offers shall be handled through ROI Corporation, as AGENT FOR THE VENDOR, on ROI Corporation’s standard offer documentation and that I will seek independent legal advice for review prior to issuing my signature."}, {"id": 17, "field": "source_text", "start": 4557, "end": 4647, "text": "This Agreement is valid for 36 months and will expire 3 years from the date it was signed."}, {"id": 18, "field": "source_text", "start": 4648, "end": 4653, "text": "Per: "}, {"id": 19, "field": "source_text", "start": 4653, "end": 4697, "text": "___________________________________________ "}, {"id": 20, "field": "source_text", "start": 4697, "end": 4703, "text": "date: "}, {"id": 21, "field": "source_text", "start": 4703, "end": 4721, "text": "__________________"}, {"id": 22, "field": "source_text", "start": 4722, "end": 4751, "text": "_____________________________"}, {"id": 23, "field": "source_text", "start": 4752, "end": 4778, "text": "Please print name of above"}, {"id": 24, "field": "source_text", "start": 4779, "end": 4809, "text": "______________________________"}], "read_question": "Read the complete agreement independently of any hypothesis. Identify the role classes that an operative clause affirmatively authorizes to receive or access Confidential Information, resolving definitions only when an operative authorization actually incorporates them. Also identify operative employee or third-party nondisclosure restrictions and their exception relationship. Preserve permissions subject to intrinsic need-to-know, purpose, or pre-existing confidentiality qualifications; distinguish those qualifications from a requirement to obtain new consent. Exclude bare recipient mentions, information descriptions, recitals, and duties that do not establish permission. Use the most specific audience rule where clauses overlap, and do not transfer safeguards or recipient classes from another agreement.", "fields": {"operative_disclosure_recipient_classes": {"domain": ["employee", "internal_personnel_unspecified", "director", "officer", "contractor", "consultant", "agent", "legal_advisor", "financial_advisor", "professional_advisor", "accountant", "lender", "none_explicit"], "name": "operative_disclosure_recipient_classes", "question": "Which recipient classes are affirmatively covered by an operative voluntary disclosure, access, or internal-sharing authorization? Include a class incorporated coherently by safeguards attached to the authorized recipients. Exclude classes found only in definitions, recitals, prohibitions, or bare mentions. Use internal_personnel_unspecified for an express general internal-sharing authorization. Use none_explicit only when the complete source supports that no recipient class is operatively authorized.", "type": "array"}, "ordinary_disclosure_restriction_relations": {"domain": ["employee_requires_new_consent", "employee_unconditionally_prohibited", "employee_has_independent_purpose_exception", "third_party_requires_new_consent", "third_party_unconditionally_prohibited", "third_party_has_independent_purpose_exception", "none_determinative"], "name": "ordinary_disclosure_restriction_relations", "question": "What operative restrictions govern ordinary voluntary disclosure to employees or third parties when they are not otherwise affirmatively authorized? A requirement for newly obtained consent or permission is a restriction, not present authorization. Record an independent-purpose exception only when it genuinely qualifies the applicable audience restriction; a generic purpose exception does not override a separate, more specific third-party consent rule. Do not infer an employee-specific prohibition from generic references to another person unless employees are expressly within that restriction. Use none_determinative only after reviewing the complete source.", "type": "array"}}}, "output_schema": {"type": "object", "properties": {"operative_disclosure_recipient_classes": {"type": "object", "properties": {"status": {"type": "string", "enum": ["known", "unknown"]}, "value": {"type": ["array", "null"], "items": {"type": "string", "enum": ["employee", "internal_personnel_unspecified", "director", "officer", "contractor", "consultant", "agent", "legal_advisor", "financial_advisor", "professional_advisor", "accountant", "lender", "none_explicit"]}, "uniqueItems": true, "maxItems": 13}, "support_ids": {"type": "array", "maxItems": 25, "items": {"type": "integer", "minimum": 0, "maximum": 24}}}, "required": ["status", "value", "support_ids"], "additionalProperties": false}, "ordinary_disclosure_restriction_relations": {"type": "object", "properties": {"status": {"type": "string", "enum": ["known", "unknown"]}, "value": {"type": ["array", "null"], "items": {"type": "string", "enum": ["employee_requires_new_consent", "employee_unconditionally_prohibited", "employee_has_independent_purpose_exception", "third_party_requires_new_consent", "third_party_unconditionally_prohibited", "third_party_has_independent_purpose_exception", "none_determinative"]}, "uniqueItems": true, "maxItems": 7}, "support_ids": {"type": "array", "maxItems": 25, "items": {"type": "integer", "minimum": 0, "maximum": 24}}}, "required": ["status", "value", "support_ids"], "additionalProperties": false}}, "required": ["operative_disclosure_recipient_classes", "ordinary_disclosure_restriction_relations"], "additionalProperties": false}}
